observed_original_abi.calling_convention_observation: ECX is dereferenced at all nineteen receiver displacements and is never written through any other register. The terminator is `C2 08 00` (RET 0x8) at thirteen separate sites -- 0x00e3a2e2, 0x00e3a31b, 0x00e3a334, 0x00e3a361, 0x00e3a387, 0x00e3a3a0, 0x00e3a416, 0x00e3a44f, 0x00e3a49e, 0x00e3a4bb, 0x00e3a506, 0x00e3a543, 0x00e3a568 -- so the callee pops its own eight bytes of stack arguments. That rules out cdecl (which needs an ADD ESP in the body and a bare RET) and fastcall (which puts the first ordinary argument in EDX). The convention is derived from the body's own bytes, not from the evidence pack's ABI record, which was read before the listing and independently agrees.
ordinary_stack_arguments: entry_ESP+0x4: a 32-bit selector, read once at 0x00e3a270 by `MOV EAX,[ESP+0x4]` and never written. All twenty-seven dispatch compares are against it.
entry_ESP+0x8: a POINTER to a property record, read at ten sites. Exactly one word of it is ever read, at +0x0c, and that word is used as a BASE (two levels of indirection), never as a value.
observed_original_abi.stack_evidence: The body performs no PUSH other than the three argument pushes before its calls, no POP, no SUB ESP and no MOV EBP,ESP. There is no frame, so entry_ESP+0x4 and entry_ESP+0x8 are the only two stack words it can name. It saves no registers.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: Path-dependent, and the listing fixes the content per path even though nothing fixes its MEANING. Four distinct endings: no matching case leaves EAX holding the selector itself (the JNZ at 0x00e3a2ba / 0x00e3a3a0 / 0x00e3a361 / 0x00e3a334 / 0x00e3a4de / 0x00e3a462 / 0x00e3a515 jumps to the shared RET with no arm run); the four-store arm at 0x00e3a3e2 and the three-store arm at 0x00e3a517 leave the value-block POINTER (`MOV EAX,[EAX+0xc]` at 0x00e3a40a and 0x00e3a537); the tag and lazy arms leave the loaded data word; the three calling arms leave the CALLEE's return value forwarded untouched, since only `ADD ESP,0xc` and `RET 0x8` follow each call. The model reproduces the register's content per path and claims nothing about what it means. The single caller in this binary (0x00e3fc73 inside the function at 0x00e3f970) does not read EAX after its call, so nothing here shows that any caller consumes it.

observed_mechanics.listing_source: Ghidra MCP: disassemble_function(0x00e3a270) on program SporeApp.exe; decompile_function(0x00e3a270); decompile_function(0x00e39420); read_memory(0x00e3a33a, 10); read_memory(0x01654c00, 24)
observed_mechanics.body_bytes: 0x00e3a270..0x00e3a56a inclusive, 763 bytes, 172 instructions. The six bytes after 0x00e3a56a are INT3 padding and are not part of the body.
instructions: The dispatch is a SIGNED binary search tree over twenty-seven 32-bit selector ids. All seven ordering branches are JG: `0F 8F rel32` at 0x00e3a279, 0x00e3a28a, 0x00e3a297, 0x00e3a3a8, 0x00e3a3b9 and 0x00e3a4c3, and the short form `7F rel8` at 0x00e3a33c.

SIGNEDNESS CONFIRMED FROM RAW BYTES, not from a mnemonic. read_memory(0x00e3a33a, 10) returns 32 d8 7f 4c 0f 84 d3 01 00 00, i.e. `CMP EAX,0xd832b059` / `JG +0x1d3`. Opcode 0x7F is JG rel8, which is signed.

The root pivot is 0xf278934a (the body's first compare, 0x00e3a274) and is itself NEGATIVE read as int32. Fifteen of the twenty-seven selector values have the high bit set; twelve are positive. The fifteen negatives compare against the root identically under a signed and an unsigned reading, so a wrong reconstruction routes them correctly by luck; the twelve positives do not, and under an unsigned reading they fall BELOW the root into the low half whose seven leaf tests (0xaaf6aaac, 0x9f792b4c, 0x8133fb2e, 0x980e43f2, 0x99f0d1da, 0xa0973374, 0xa6cb4c9f) are all negative values -- so all twelve match nothing, write nothing and call nothing. The model spells every ordering compare signed_greater() and the model test drives all twenty-seven through both readings.

The arms are NOT a chain and the tree shape is reproduced. Several blocks are reached from more than one branch and the model shares them as lambdas exactly as the bytes do: 0x00e3a2c0 from four JZ plus two fall-throughs, 0x00e3a3e2 from three JZ plus one fall-through, 0x00e3a517 from nine JZ plus one fall-through, 0x00e3a546 from three JZ, 0x00e3a4e4 from two JZ plus one fall-through.

Ten distinct blocks exist. Six arms write a value unconditionally, three write a PRIMARY receiver word only while it is still zero, and four of the arms first write a tag immediate into +0x32c behind a `CMP DWORD PTR [ECX+0x32c],0xffffffff` / JNZ guard. Five tag immediates appear: 0x1654c00 (unguarded, the body's only unguarded tag store), 0x1654c01, 0x1654c02, 0x1654c04, 0x1654c05. 0x1654c03 never appears anywhere in the body.

THE STORE ORDER IN THE THREE LAZY ARMS IS LOAD-BEARING. In each, the machine compares the primary receiver word against zero at 0x00e3a2f8 / 0x00e3a42c / 0x00e3a47b, but the JNZ acting on that comparison is three or four instructions LATER at 0x00e3a30f / 0x00e3a443 / 0x00e3a492, AFTER the secondary word has already been stored. So the secondary store is UNCONDITIONAL and the primary store is the conditional one. The intervening MOVs do not touch the flags.

The body has exactly ONE null test: `TEST EAX,EAX` / `JZ 0x00e3a568` at 0x00e3a51b/0x00e3a51d, on the three-store arm at 0x00e3a517, which is reached by ten selectors. A null record there returns having written nothing at all, not even a tag.

The four-store arm at 0x00e3a3e2 stores its middle pair SWAPPED with respect to source order: q[+0x0c] lands at +0x2ac and q[+0x10] lands at +0x2a8. The three-store arm at 0x00e3a517 is ASCENDING (+0x2d0, +0x2cc, +0x2d4). The two arms disagree and neither is the other's typo.
observed_mechanics.stores: Sixteen of the nineteen receiver displacements appear as memory operands under ECX and account for every store the body makes. The remaining three -- 0x29c, 0x2b4, 0x2c0 -- are produced by `ADD ECX,<disp>` and then PUSHed (0x00e3a2d0/0x00e3a4f4/0x00e3a556), so the listing shows no memory operand under them: this body never writes those twelve bytes, the callee does. The largest displacement the body can touch is +0x32c and every access there is a dword, so 0x330 is the last byte reachable.
observed_mechanics.constants: Twenty-seven `CMP EAX,<imm32>` selector immediates; five tag immediates 0x1654c00..0x1654c05 (0x1654c03 absent); the guard compare value -1 (0xffffffff); the callee's `PUSH 0x3` at 0x00e3a2d7/0x00e3a4fb/0x00e3a55d; the three destination displacements 0x2c0/0x2b4/0x29c; and the nineteen receiver displacements. No other 32-bit immediate appears in the dispatch.
observed_mechanics.control_flow: One entry (0x00e3a270), one shared epilogue block (0x00e3a568: RET 0x8) that every unmatched path and every fall-through reaches, twelve further RET 0x8 sites inside the arms, three direct calls, and no loop of any kind -- no instruction in the body branches backwards. Every backward branch (0x00e3a38f -> 0x00e3a2c0, 0x00e3a4cc -> 0x00e3a3e2, 0x00e3a3a3's subtree re-entry) is a dispatch jump to a shared arm, not a cycle.
observed_mechanics.indirect_transfers: None. No instruction in the 172 is a register- or memory-operand transfer, so there is no indirect call and no indirect jump. The xref export records 0 vtable references for this function. The body also never reads the receiver's +0x00, so it names no slot boundary and no member there. The model declares no vtable and no slot table.

type_scope: The three structures exist only to give the nineteen receiver displacements and the two indirection levels somewhere typed to live. Simulator declares NO members on purpose: the machine-derived receiver record in the evidence pack is bounds_only and enumerates a single displacement, the complete listing shows sixteen under that register, and no machine record anywhere in this repository names a member at any displacement.
